title: Messages
subtitle: E-mails and SMS from templates and with AI help – sent with your own mail and phone
subject: Subject
personal: This text contains no data about people (e.g. a letter to a school about a programme)
personalText: Then the cloud AI works without pseudonymisation. Leave it off if the message is about a specific person.

send.hint: You send the message yourself – from your own mail or phone. Przystań has no server and sends nothing on your behalf without your tap.
send.long: The text is long – some mail apps cut such messages. Use “Copy” and paste the text into an e-mail.
send.handedOff: Handed over to the app – send it there
send.gateWarning: The text passes through the sms-gate.app server.
send.sentPhoneUnconfirmed: SMS handed to the network (not confirmed)

gmailError.noClientId: Gmail is not set up – Settings → Notifications and messages.
gmailError.popup: The browser blocked the Google window – allow pop-ups.
gmailError.auth: Google did not grant the permission: {{msg}}
gmailError.unavailable: Gmail is not available right now.

phoneError.DENIED: Android denied Przystań access to SMS
phoneError.INVALID: Check the number and the text.
phoneError.FAILED: The SMS could not be sent: {{msg}}

send.phoneDeniedHelp: Android blocks SMS for apps installed outside the Play Store. In app settings: ⋮ (top right) → "Allow restricted settings" → confirm → Permissions → SMS → Allow. Then send again.

ai.title: AI help
ai.writeHint: Say what the message should contain (e.g. “remind about the meeting on Thursday at 10, ask for confirmation”).
ai.instruction: What do you want to say?
ai.intention: What do you want to answer? (optional)
ai.intentionHint: e.g. “I agree to a meeting but cannot share details of the therapy”
ai.useKnowledge: Use knowledge from the app (knowledge cards, help system, law)
ai.useClient: Include basic information about the person (stage of change, goal, context – nothing identifying)
ai.empty: First write a text or an instruction.

contacts.empty: No contacts. Add addresses you often write to (school, probation officer, parent).
contacts.name: Name
contacts.privacy: Contacts are encrypted like all data. Store only what you need for your work.

entry.reminderHint: SMS or e-mail reminding about this meeting

meetingReminder.title: Meeting reminder
meetingReminder.subject: Reminder: meeting on {{date}} at {{time}}
meetingReminder.body:
Hello{{recipientComma}},

just a reminder of our meeting on {{date}} at {{time}}{{placeIn}}.
If the time does not suit you, please let me know and we will find another one.

Kind regards
{{signature}}
meetingReminder.sms: Hello, a reminder of our meeting on {{date}} at {{time}}{{placeIn}}. If you can't come, please let me know. {{me}}

meetingChange.title: Meeting rescheduled
meetingChange.subject: New time for our meeting
meetingChange.body:
Hello{{recipientComma}},

unfortunately I have to move our meeting planned for {{date}} at {{time}}. I suggest [new time]. Please confirm or suggest another time.

Sorry for the change and kind regards
{{signature}}
meetingChange.sms: Hello, I need to move our meeting on {{date}} {{time}}. I suggest [new time] – please confirm. {{me}}

missedMeeting.title: After a missed meeting
missedMeeting.subject: Our meeting on {{date}}
missedMeeting.body:
Hello{{recipientComma}},

we did not see each other on {{date}} – I hope everything is fine. I am happy to arrange a new time. Please get in touch whenever it suits you.

Kind regards
{{signature}}
missedMeeting.sms: Hello, we didn't see each other on {{date}}. I hope you're OK – let me know when we can meet. {{me}}

guardianInfo.title: To a parent / guardian – invitation to cooperate
guardianInfo.subject: Invitation to a meeting
guardianInfo.body:
Dear [name],

I would like to invite you to a conversation about supporting [child's name]. The aim is to agree together how we can help – not to judge. I suggest [date] at [place].

I will discuss the details of my work with [child's name] in person, respecting confidentiality.

Kind regards
{{signature}}

schoolOpinion.title: To a school – request for a report
schoolOpinion.subject: Request for a report on a pupil
schoolOpinion.body:
Dear colleagues,

for [purpose, e.g. preparing a support plan] I kindly ask for a short report on the pupil [initials, class]: attendance, relationships with peers, strengths, difficulties and the support provided so far.

The parent's/guardian's consent to share information [is available / is attached]. Please send the report by [date] via [official channel].

Kind regards
{{signature}}

referral.title: Referral to an institution
referral.subject: Referral / request for an appointment
referral.body:
Dear colleagues,

I am writing to ask for a consultation / admission for a person I work with (with their consent). I will share the key information by phone or in a secure way.

[referral text]

Please let me know about possible dates and the documents needed.

Kind regards
{{signature}}

courtReport.title: To a court / probation officer – information
courtReport.subject: Information regarding [case number]
courtReport.body:
Dear [name],

in response to your request of [date] I am sending information within the scope you asked for: [attendance, activities – facts and dates].

A more detailed report requires a written form – if needed I will prepare it through the official channel.

Kind regards
{{signature}}

supervisionRequest.title: Request for supervision
supervisionRequest.subject: Request for a supervision appointment
supervisionRequest.body:
Hello{{recipientComma}},

I would like to arrange a supervision session. It concerns my work with [Person A] – [briefly, nothing identifying: what I find difficult]. Would [date] suit you?

Kind regards
{{signature}}

preventionInvite.title: Invitation to a prevention programme
preventionInvite.subject: Invitation: {{program}}
preventionInvite.body:
Dear all,

I would like to invite you to the prevention programme “{{program}}”. The programme is interactive, builds social skills and follows evidence-based prevention recommendations. Planned dates: [dates]. For parents we plan [an information evening].

I am happy to answer any questions.

Kind regards
{{signature}}

acknowledge.title: Confirmation of receipt
acknowledge.subject: Re: [subject]
acknowledge.body:
Hello{{recipientComma}},

thank you for your message – I confirm I have received it. I will reply by [date].

Kind regards
{{signature}}
acknowledge.sms: Hello, thank you for your message – I'll get back to you by [date]. {{me}}

thanks.title: Thank you for the cooperation
thanks.subject: Thank you for working together
thanks.body:
Hello{{recipientComma}},

thank you for our cooperation and [a concrete example]. It really helps our work.

Warm regards
{{signature}}
